diagnosis: Candidate/bad runs overproduce repetitive interaction loops, especially repeated clicks, no-ops, and scrolling.
expected_mechanism: Detecting unchanged outcomes forces strategy revision or termination, reducing unproductive loops and improving completion efficiency. Cost: small state-tracking overhead and occasional premature switching when repetition is genuinely necessary.
policy_text: Before repeating an action or materially equivalent action, compare the latest outcome with prior outcomes. If no new state or information was gained, do not retry unchanged; revise the target, method, or assumptions. After two unchanged attempts, explicitly choose a different strategy or stop with the blocker.

quantitative_evidence.finding: result:repeated has +1,261 operations (bad excess), accounting for 11.31% of the differential profile; result:terminal is -92 (good excess).
Within repeated outcomes, bad excess is concentrated in click (+639), noop (+356), and scroll (+277), while fill (-12), select_option (-21), and send_msg_to_user (-17) favor good runs.
Inspection behavior contains +602 repeated outcomes, alongside +990 clicks and +520 scrolls, showing the repetition is embedded in recurring inspect/interact loops.
